order: Correct the P0 Quartermaster's DEFAULT review-draw forecast (ruling R4). The prior derivation sustained the PEAK review arrival rate across a full 168h week to reach mandatoryReviewDraw = 0.504, which pushed the default requiredReserve to ~0.6552 — above the ladder's 40% Green threshold, so the P15 gate fired on nearly any bucket. That derivation fabricates load: no week runs entirely at burst rate. Replace the default with WO-2's directly MEASURED weekly draw (mandatoryReviewDraw = 0.03 — the same throughput probe that castings.reserve.twoGateClassReviewsCostSource cites). Leave incidentDraw at 0 as a disclosed under-estimate. Preserve the rejected peak-derived arithmetic (0.504, ~0.6552) in the comments as the cautionary alternative, computed but unused. requiredReserve(default) = 0.03 x 1.3 = 0.039 sits below the plan's own 8% floor, so the floor governs the default. IN SCOPE — these files, these behaviours, and nothing else: - quartermaster/quartermaster.js: defaultForecast() and the ruling-R4 comment block that documents its derivation. - quartermaster/README.md: the R4 section — record both derivations, the adopted measured-based one and the rejected peak-based one. - tests/quartermaster.test.js: the pinned R4 values, plus an explicit check that the 8% floor (not the 0.039 dynamic term) governs. OUT OF SCOPE: every other behaviour of the Quartermaster seat. The explicit forecast-override path, the freshness/staleness rules, the fail-closed refusals, the malformed-line accounting, the confirmation protocol, the throttle-prediction method and the report/snapshot output are to be left exactly as they are.
